title: William S. Hart and the Early "Western" Film
titleZh: 威廉·S·哈特和早期“西部”片
question: How did William Hart's childhood prepare him for his acting role in Western films?

meanings.meaning: 未受到挑战的；无人质疑的
meanings.usage: 用来描述地位、观点等没有受到反对或质疑

meanings.meaning: 渐渐渗透的；逐步侵蚀的
meanings.usage: 用来描述缓慢侵入、侵占原本不属于自己的领域的事物

meanings.meaning: 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的
meanings.usage: 常用来形容不好的事情即将到来，如危险、灾难等

phrases.usage: 用来强调除了提到的事物之外没有其他，相当于only

examples.en: Unlike Gary Cooper and John Wayne he appeared in nothing but Westerns.
examples.zh: 和加里·库珀以及约翰·韦恩不同，他只出演西部片。

examples.en: After the accident, he could remember nothing but his childhood.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，他除了自己的童年什么都记不起来了。

phrases.usage: 表示事物的根源、基础来源于某处，强调稳固的起源

examples.en: His hero was firmly rooted in his memories and experiences.
examples.zh: 他塑造的英雄角色牢牢扎根于他的记忆和经历之中。

examples.en: The traditional custom is rooted in local culture stretching back thousands of years.
examples.zh: 这个传统习俗扎根于延续数千年的当地文化中。

phrases.usage: 字面意思是“牵手”，常引申为合作、联合、共同达成某一目标

examples.en: Myth and reality did join hands in at least one arena.
examples.zh: 至少在一个领域里神话和现实确实是共存共通的。

examples.en: The two countries will join hands to develop new energy technology.
examples.zh: 两国将携手开发新能源技术。

phrases.usage: 表示习惯于某事物，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Men accustomed to struggling for survival against the elements and Indians were bewildered by politicians.
examples.zh: 那些习惯了与自然和印第安人搏斗求生的人被政客们搞得晕头转向。

examples.en: She is accustomed to working late and getting up early the next day.
examples.zh: 她习惯了熬夜工作，第二天又早起。

phrases.usage: 表示与……有冲突、有矛盾，可指人和人之间，也可指人自身的思想矛盾

examples.en: The individual in conflict with himself and his frontier environment.
examples.zh: 与自身以及边疆环境相冲突的个体。

examples.en: His idea is in conflict with the general plan of the team.
examples.zh: 他的想法和团队的整体规划相冲突。

sentences.en: William S. Hart was, perhaps, the greatest of all Western stars,
sentences.zh: 威廉·S·哈特也许是所有西部片明星中最伟大的。

sentences.en: for unlike Gary Cooper and John Wayne he appeared in nothing but Westerns.
sentences.zh: 因为他不像加里·库珀和约翰·韦恩那样，他只出演西部片。

sentences.en: From 1914 to 1924 he was supreme and unchallenged.
sentences.zh: 从1914到1924年，他独领风骚，无人能及。

sentences.en: It was Hart who created the basic formula of the Western film,
sentences.zh: 是哈特创造了西部片的基本模式，

sentences.en: and devised the protagonist he played in every film he made,
sentences.zh: 并设计了他所主演的每部影片中的主角，

sentences.en: the good-bad man, the accidental, noble outlaw,
sentences.zh: 亦正亦邪的好坏人，偶然成为的正直的歹徒，

sentences.en: or the honest, but framed cowboy, or the sheriff made suspect by vicious gossip;
sentences.zh: 或是诚实但遭诬陷的牛仔，或是因流言蜚语而受到怀疑的警长；

sentences.en: in short, the individual in conflict with himself and his frontier environment.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，就是与自己和其边疆环境相冲突的个体。

sentences.en: Unlike most of his contemporaries in Hollywood,
sentences.zh: 与他在好莱坞的大多数同时代演员不同，

sentences.en: Hart actually knew something of the old West.
sentences.zh: 哈特确实了解一些旧西部。

sentences.en: He had lived in it as a child when it was already disappearing,
sentences.zh: 他小时候曾生活在那个已经逐渐消失的西部，

sentences.en: and his hero was firmly rooted in his memories and experiences,
sentences.zh: 他的英雄人物深深扎根于他的记忆和经历中，

sentences.en: and in both the history and the mythology of the vanished frontier,
sentences.zh: 以及在消逝边疆的历史和神话中。

sentences.en: And although no period or place in American history has been more absurdly romanticized,
sentences.zh: 尽管美国历史上没有任何一个时期或地方比西部更被荒谬地浪漫化，

sentences.en: myth and reality did join hands in at least one arena,
sentences.zh: 但神话和现实至少在一个领域联手了，

sentences.en: the conflict between the individual and encroaching civilization.
sentences.zh: 那就是个体与入侵文明之间的冲突。

sentences.en: Men accustomed to struggling for survival against the elements and Indians
sentences.zh: 习惯于与自然元素和印第安人斗争求生的人们，

sentences.en: were bewildered by politicians, bankers and businessmen,
sentences.zh: 被政客、银行家和商人搞得手足无措，

sentences.en: and unhorsed by fences, laws and alien taboos.
sentences.zh: 被篱笆、法律和陌生的禁忌所限制。

sentences.en: Hart's good-bad man was always an outsider, always one of the disinherited,
sentences.zh: 哈特的“亦正亦邪的好坏人”总是一个局外人，一个被剥夺继承权的人，

sentences.en: and if he found it necessary to shoot a sheriff or rob a bank along the way,
sentences.zh: 如果他觉得有必要射杀一名警长或沿途抢劫一家银行，

sentences.en: his early audiences found it easy to understand and forgive,
sentences.zh: 他的早期观众很容易理解并原谅，

sentences.en: especially when it was Hart who, in the end, overcame the attacking Indians.
sentences.zh: 尤其当最终是哈特击败了来犯的印第安人时。

sentences.en: Audiences in the second decade of the twentieth century
sentences.zh: 二十世纪第二个十年的观众

sentences.en: found it pleasant to escape to a time when life, though hard, was relatively simple.
sentences.zh: 乐于逃到一个虽然艰辛但相对简单的时代。

sentences.en: We still do; living in a world in which undeclared aggression, war, hypocrisy,
sentences.zh: 我们现在仍然如此；生活在一个不宣而战的侵略、战争、虚伪、

sentences.en: chicanery, anarchy and impending immolation are part of our daily lives,
sentences.zh: 诡计、无政府状态和即将到来的毁灭是我们日常生活一部分的世界里，

sentences.en: we all want a code to live by.
sentences.zh: 我们都渴望有一个行为准则。

grammar.title: 强调句 (Emphatic Sentence)
grammar.definition: 用来突出强调句子某一部分（通常是主语、宾语、状语）的句式，不强调时可以还原为普通陈述句
grammar.structure: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分
grammar.usage: 当被强调部分是人时，连接词可以用who，其他情况一律用that；该结构不强调谓语动词

examples.en: It was Hart who created the basic formula of the Western film.
examples.zh: 正是哈特创造了西部片的基本范式。

examples.en: It was not until I got home that I realized I had left my keys in the office.
examples.zh: 直到我回到家我才意识到我把钥匙落在了办公室。

grammar.title: 现在分词短语作定语
grammar.definition: 现在分词可以放在名词后面作定语，相当于一个定语从句，用来描述该名词的特征或正在进行的动作
grammar.structure: 名词 + 现在分词短语
grammar.usage: 当分词的动作是由所修饰的名词主动发出时，用现在分词作定语，可和被修饰名词构成逻辑上的主谓关系

examples.en: We still do; living in a world in which undeclared aggression, war, hypocrisy, chicanery, anarchy and impending immolation are part of our daily lives, we all want a code to live by.
examples.zh: 我们仍然如此；生活在一个不宣而战的侵略、战争、虚伪、欺诈、无政府状态和迫在眉睫的毁灭都成为日常生活一部分的世界里，我们都需要一套赖以生存的行为准则。

examples.en: The girl standing by the window is my younger sister.
examples.zh: 站在窗边的那个女孩是我的妹妹。

patterns.pattern: It is/was + 被强调的人 + who + 剩余句子成分

original.en: It was Hart who created the basic formula of the Western film, and devised the protagonist he played in every film he made.
original.zh: 正是哈特创造了西部片的基本范式，并且设计出了他在自己每一部电影中扮演的主角形象。

examples.en: It was Edison who invented the practical incandescent light bulb and changed the way people live at night.
examples.zh: 正是爱迪生发明了实用的白炽灯泡，改变了人们夜间的生活方式。

examples.en: It was my mother who taught me to be honest and kind to others when I was a little child.
examples.zh: 正是我的母亲在我小的时候就教我要为人诚实、与人为善。

patterns.pattern: find it + 形容词 + to do sth.

original.en: Audiences in the second decade of the twentieth century found it pleasant to escape to a time when life, though hard, was relatively simple.
original.zh: 20世纪第二个十年的观众发现，逃到一个虽然艰苦但相对简单的时代是很愉快的。

examples.en: Many young people find it difficult to balance work and personal life in big cities.
examples.zh: 很多年轻人发现在大城市里很难平衡工作和个人生活。

examples.en: I find it necessary to learn a second foreign language in the context of globalization.
examples.zh: 我发现在全球化的背景下，学习第二门外语是很有必要的。

patterns.pattern: unlike + 名词/代词, + 主句

original.en: Unlike most of his contemporaries in Hollywood, Hart actually knew something of the old West.
original.zh: 和他在好莱坞的大多数同代人不同，哈特确实了解旧日西部的一些情况。

examples.en: Unlike most of his classmates, Tom prefers to spend his spare time reading rather than playing games.
examples.zh: 和他的大多数同学不同，汤姆更喜欢把业余时间花在阅读上而不是打游戏。

examples.en: Unlike other social media platforms, this app focuses on providing users with professional learning resources.
examples.zh: 和其他社交媒体平台不同，这款应用专注于为用户提供专业的学习资源。
